description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces, includes, macros, and external function declarations related to firewall management in a network device or system. It contains function prototypes for firewall setup, IP address retrieval, and conditional features such as WAN failover, extender mode, and WiFi management.

methods.name: do_logs
methods.description: Function to perform logging related tasks within the firewall context.

methods.name: do_wan2self_attack
methods.description: Handles attack detection or handling for WAN to self attacks, logging to the provided file pointer.

methods.name: prepare_ipv4_firewall
methods.description: Prepares IPv4 firewall rules based on the provided configuration file.

methods.name: prepare_ipv6_firewall
methods.description: Prepares IPv6 firewall rules based on the provided configuration file.

methods.name: get_ip6address
methods.description: Retrieves IPv6 addresses for a specified interface, considering scope.

methods.name: redirect_dns_to_extender
methods.description: Redirects DNS traffic to an extender, applicable in WAN failover with IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: get_iface_ipaddr
methods.description: Retrieves IP address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: add_if_mss_clamping
methods.description: Adds MSS clamping rule to mangle chain for IPv4 or IPv6, if WiFi management is supported.

methods.name: service_start_ext_mode
methods.description: Starts the extender service mode if supported.

methods.name: prepare_ipv4_rule_ex_mode
methods.description: Prepares IPv4 firewall rules in extender mode.

methods.name: prepare_ipv6_rule_ex_mode
methods.description: Prepares IPv6 firewall rules in extender mode.

methods.name: isExtProfile
methods.description: Checks if the device is running in extender profile mode.

methods.name: updateManageWiFiRules
methods.description: Updates WiFi management rules if supported.

methods.name: isManageWiFiEnabled
methods.description: Checks if WiFi management is enabled.
